baseline_models.focus_anchor: The plural noun ٱلرُّسُلُ is the patient of the passive أُقِّتَتْ.
baseline_models.mechanism: An external authority fixes a known occasion for the messengers, so the line presents an imposed appointment rather than a time they choose.

activation_trace.role: The envoy-and-message branch supplies the direct personal sense: the envoys are the parties placed under appointment.
The known-time branch supplies the measured occasion imposed by the passive verb.

changed_reading.before: The messengers merely appear in a temporal scene.
changed_reading.after: The messengers are made subject to a known, externally fixed appointment.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The dispatch image in ٱلرُّسُلُ meets the limit-setting force of أُقِّتَتْ.
baseline_models.mechanism: Timing can bound an action by its endpoint; applied to sent envoys, the passive marks the limit of their commissioned phase, not merely a date on a calendar.

activation_trace.role: Being sent forth supplies an active commission whose duration can end.
Appointing or bounding by a limit turns the time into the commission's terminal boundary.

changed_reading.before: A meeting involving messengers is scheduled.
changed_reading.after: The messengers' period of being sent is brought to its assigned limit.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The plural ٱلرُّسُلُ can be heard through the succession-in-batches branch, while أُقِّتَتْ can evoke an appointed time or station.
baseline_models.mechanism: Successive dispatched cohorts are synchronized at one rendezvous, or allotted ordered appointments, converting an undifferentiated plural into a coordinated sequence.

activation_trace.role: Successive groups supply the cohort structure latent in the plural messengers.
An appointed time or station supplies the rendezvous that coordinates the cohorts.

changed_reading.before: All messengers form one static group at a set time.
changed_reading.after: Successive messenger cohorts are coordinated into a common rendezvous or ordered docket.

context_deltas.mechanism: The opening sequence supplies dispatch, connected succession, spreading, differentiation, and delivery of a reminder. The focus appointment can therefore be the checkpoint at which an earlier transmission relay reaches completion and becomes answerable.

activation_trace.role: Successive messenger cohorts anchor the proposed relay in the focus noun.
Bounding an action by a time supplies the relay's terminal checkpoint.
The opening dispatched ones literally carry the image of groups proceeding in succession.
Connected succession supplies continuity between otherwise separate dispatched cohorts.
Opening, spreading, and branching supply the relay's outward distribution phase.
Distinguishing between things supplies the relay's sorting function.
Casting something until it is delivered supplies the relay's handoff action.
The reminder supplies the content transmitted through the proposed chain.

structural_cues: 77:1-6 forms a linked run of feminine plurals and emphatic cognate accusatives, moving from dispatch toward the casting of a reminder.
The focus returns to a feminine-plural subject but changes the sequence from active functions to passive timing.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the ordered action sequence and compatible branch images; I infer that they are stages of one relay whose accountability point is 77:11. A live alternative is that the opening items name distinct agents or events rather than stages of a single process.

changed_reading.before: Successive messenger cohorts simply receive appointments.
changed_reading.after: A distributed reminder-bearing relay reaches its imposed completion and accountability checkpoint.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediate question and answer identify the appointment as deferment to the Day of Separation, while the later recurrence of that title couples it to gathering. The focus thus becomes a collective adjudicative session rather than an unspecified appointment.

activation_trace.role: The envoy sense supplies the commissioned parties reserved for the hearing.
A fixed temporal limit anchors the focus event as an imposed deadline.
A bounded duration supplies the temporal container explicitly asked about after the focus.
The fixed end of a term sharpens timing into deferment until a deadline.
Judgment separating truth from falsehood supplies the appointment's adjudicative purpose.
A day, place, or summons that gathers people supplies the collective-session architecture.

structural_cues: 77:12 asks to which day the passive event was deferred, and 77:13 answers directly: the Day of Separation.
77:38 repeats the Day of Separation and immediately states a gathering.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet explicitly supplies deferment, adjudicative separation, and a later gathering; I infer that the messengers' appointment is part of that collective hearing. The materially live alternative is that 77:38 gathers the addressees and earlier peoples without specifying that the messengers share the same assembly role.

changed_reading.before: The messengers are assigned an unspecified known time.
changed_reading.after: The messengers are reserved for a collective hearing at the fixed Day of adjudicative separation.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus is the fourth member of a passive transformation series: visible celestial signs are erased, the overhead enclosure is breached, solid landmarks are uprooted, and then the sent envoys are bounded. Their timing reads as decommissioning one operative order during a total cosmic reset.

activation_trace.role: Being sent forth supplies the commissioned operation that can be closed.
Bounding an action by its endpoint supplies the proposed decommissioning limit.
The literal stars supply the visible celestial markers affected in the first parallel clause.
Erasure of trace supplies the removal of those ordinary markers.
Opening a breach supplies the rupture of the enclosing order.
A solid elevated mass supplies the stable landmark removed in the next clause.
Uprooting and removal supply that landmark's decommissioning.

structural_cues: 77:8-11 repeats إذا with a plural or collective subject followed by a feminine singular passive perfect.
The focus occupies the culminating slot in this uninterrupted four-clause series.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies syntactic parallelism and three preceding removals of operative features; I infer that timing the messengers likewise closes their commissioned phase. A live alternative is simple simultaneity: their appointment may occur during the reset without itself being a decommissioning.

changed_reading.before: The appointment is an ordinary calendar event within the existing world order.
changed_reading.after: The appointment is the terminal transformation of commissioned agency as the old cosmic order is dismantled.

context_deltas.mechanism: The delivered reminder first opens excuse or warning, repeated denial contests it, and the later judgment scene removes speech permission and excuse. The timed messengers can therefore mark the evidentiary cutoff at which message-bearing testimony stands and counter-speech closes.

activation_trace.role: The branch joins envoy with carried speech, anchoring the proposed evidentiary carrier.
A fixed endpoint supplies the cutoff after which rebuttal is unavailable.
A remembrance functioning as a right-record supplies the proposed documentary force of the delivered message.
Excuse or exculpation supplies one possible effect of the prior delivery.
Warning that awakens caution supplies the alternative prosecutive effect of the delivery.
Attributing the message or bearer to falsehood supplies the recurring contest over the evidence.
Literal speech supplies the response channel that the judgment scene closes.
Permission supplies the authorization explicitly withheld from would-be speakers.
Excuse reappears as the defense no longer permitted after the cutoff.

structural_cues: The عذر root occurs first beside warning in 77:6 and returns as a barred action in 77:36.
The repeated woe-to-deniers refrain links rejection of delivered speech to the day when speech and excuse are unavailable.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies delivered reminder, excuse or warning, repeated denial, and later loss of speech permission; I infer that the messengers or their carried speech stand as evidence at their appointment. The text does not explicitly call them witnesses, so a live alternative is a non-forensic summons with the silence scene concerning only the deniers.

changed_reading.before: The messengers merely attend at a fixed time.
changed_reading.after: Their appointment is the deadline at which delivered warning becomes standing evidence and the deniers' reply window closes.

context_deltas.mechanism: The creation sequence moves from measured formation through secure placement to a known limit. By material analogy, a messenger's commission can mature inside an ordered process until it reaches its proper measure; the appointment is a threshold of completion rather than arbitrary delay.

activation_trace.role: Dispatch supplies the commissioned process whose development is being modeled.
Bounding an action by an endpoint anchors maturation in the focus verb.
Measuring and proportioning supplies the ordered formation phase of the analogy.
Fixity and settlement supply a stable interval before the limit is reached.
A place of being supplies the bounded setting in which the process develops.
A measure reaching its limit supplies the maturation threshold mapped onto the appointment.
Knownness supplies the determinate rather than arbitrary character of that threshold.

structural_cues: 77:20-23 is an ordered process: creation, placement in a secure repository, continuation to a known measure, then an affirmation of measuring power.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a created process held until a known measure; I supply the cross-domain analogy that commissioned missions likewise ripen to a measured endpoint. The materially live alternative is that the creation passage is an independent proof of power and does not model the messengers' timing.

changed_reading.before: The appointment is an externally selected date that interrupts the missions.
changed_reading.after: The appointment is the determinate maturity point at which commissioned work reaches its proper measure.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the grammar foregrounds a plural of personal messengers, but the cited ر س ل branch explicitly includes carried speech and the surah ends by asking what later discourse could be trusted. It remains anchored as a metonymic activation of ٱلرُّسُلُ plus the endpoint force of أُقِّتَتْ; downstream prose should label it a corpus-level overlay and must not replace the personal-messenger reading with it.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The messenger-and-message branch of ٱلرُّسُلُ permits a metonymic shift from carriers to what they carry, while أُقِّتَتْ supplies closure.

activation_trace.role: The branch explicitly joins messenger and message, licensing the contained carrier-to-content shift.
A fixed limit supplies closure of the message-bearing interval.
A remembrance that can function as a document of right supplies a record-like form for the carried content.
Renewed speech or report supplies the later discourse whose credibility is challenged.
Temporal after-ness supplies the contrast between the closed message and any subsequent discourse.
Heart-settling assent supplies the trust that no later discourse is expected to win.

changed_reading.before: Only the persons of the messengers are scheduled.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the carried message corpus is docketed to closure, leaving no credible discourse after it.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is branch-distant because أُقِّتَتْ normally foregrounds time, yet the packet's miqat branch includes an appointed station and the later context supplies directed departure and a gathering-place image. The reading remains anchored in the focus timing root and plural dispatched agents; downstream prose should present spatial stationing only as a secondary overlay on temporal appointment.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The appointed-time-or-station branch of أُقِّتَتْ can spatialize the rendezvous of the dispatched plural ٱلرُّسُلُ.

activation_trace.role: Dispatch supplies agents capable of being posted or directed to a rendezvous.
The appointed time-or-station branch directly supplies the contained spatial overlay.
Unimpeded departure supplies movement toward an assigned destination.
A place, day, or summons that gathers people supplies the rendezvous topology.

changed_reading.before: The messengers are assigned only a time.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the messengers are also posted to appointed stations within the gathering's spatial choreography.

strongest_changes: 77:12-13 directly revises a neutral appointment into deferment to the Day of adjudicative separation, and 77:38 adds collective gathering.
The opening dispatch-to-reminder sequence turns the focus into the completion and accountability checkpoint of a transmission relay.
The later ban on speech and excuse turns messenger timing into an evidentiary cutoff rather than mere attendance.
summary.what_was_special: Whole-surah context made the small passive clause function in several architectures at once: the endpoint of dispatch, the fourth passive event in cosmic dismantling, a collective hearing, and the closure of a warning record. The same ر س ل root at the opening and focus was especially activating.
remaining_uncertainties: Whether ٱلرُّسُلُ should remain exclusively personal or can sustain the contained metonymic message-corpus overlay.
Whether أُقِّتَتْ primarily assigns a time, defers to a term, gathers at that term, or marks the end of commission.
Whether the measured-maturation and spatial-station readings reflect deliberate whole-surah structure or only productive branch analogies.
